accountConstraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES accounting_account(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (((subtype)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CURRENT_ASSET'::character varying, 'CASH'::character varying, 'BANK'::character varying, 'GATEWAY_CLEARING'::character varying, 'RECEIVABLE'::character varying, 'INVENTORY'::character varying, 'INPUT_TAX'::character varying, 'FIXED_ASSET'::character varying, 'CURRENT_LIABILITY'::character varying, 'PAYABLE'::character varying, 'OUTPUT_TAX'::character varying, 'STAFF_PAYABLE'::character varying, 'CUSTOMER_ADVANCE'::character varying, 'LONG_TERM_LIABILITY'::character varying, 'CAPITAL'::character varying, 'RETAINED_EARNINGS'::character varying, 'OPENING_OFFSET'::character varying, 'DIRECT_REVENUE'::character varying, 'INDIRECT_REVENUE'::character varying, 'DELIVERY_REVENUE'::character varying, 'COGS'::character varying, 'OPERATING_EXPENSE'::character varying, 'FINANCIAL_EXPENSE'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ASSET'::character varying, 'LIABILITY'::character varying, 'EQUITY'::character varying, 'REVENUE'::character varying, 'EXPENSE'::character varying])::text[])))

accountIndexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounting_account_pkey ON public.accounting_account USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_accounting_account_code ON public.accounting_account USING btree (code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_accounting_account_code ON public.accounting_account USING btree (code) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_accounting_account_type ON public.accounting_account USING btree (type, subtype)
CREATE INDEX idx_accounting_account_parent ON public.accounting_account USING btree (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_accounting_account_active ON public.accounting_account USING btree (is_active) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
